subject: Post-demo: hosting preference & migration constraints
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: hosting preference & migration constraints

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the quick demo earlier. Below is a short recap + proposed next steps so we can align on hosting mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and migration constraints from your current setup.

Recap:
- BluePeak currently runs a mix of self-hosted Llama derivatives on an on-prem GPU cluster (NVIDIA A100), plus a small production integration to another provider for low-latency inference.
- Main drivers: data residency for EU customers, predictable p99 latency for synchronous search features, and cost predictability for high-volume nightly batch embeddings.
- Security asks: SOC 2 report, ability to route traffic through BluePeak VPC, and customer-managed KMS for sensitive models.

Questions we still have (please confirm):
1) Do you require full air-gapped on-prem for any portion of traffic, or will a VPC/private deployment suffice?
2) Are there hard constraints on egress (i.e., traffic must never leave EU for EU customers)?
3) What throughput do you need for peak embedding batches (tokens/sec or embeddings/min)?

Proposed near-term options:
- Hosted API: fastest to go-live for discovery/proof-of-concept (no migration effort)
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool in our infra, predictable throughput and per-tenant isolation (minimal network setup)
- Private VPC: customer VPC peering or on-prem package for strict residency and KMS control (longer onboarding)

Next steps:
- Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up this week to capture peak QPS numbers and procurement timeline?
- I attached a short Mutual Action Plan template and a Dedicated pricing snapshot for quick reference.

Thanks — I’ll wait on your answers to the three clarifying questions, then we’ll scope the right onboarding path.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (pricing snapshot), mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx (MAP template)

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@bluepeak.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosting preference & migration constraints

Jordan — thanks for the notes and the materials. Quick answers inline below.

1) Air-gapped on-prem: Not required today. We have some customers in finance who prefer isolated VPCs; on-prem would be a later ask if we decide to keep certain models in-house. VPC or customer-managed private deployment is the requirement for now.
2) Egress: For EU customers, traffic and model inference must stay in EU regions. We can tolerate control-plane metadata leaving to US for orchestration provided data plane stays in EU.
3) Peak throughput: For nightly embedding jobs we expect ~120k embeddings/hour (batching across documents). In production serving for recommendations we need stable p99 latency under 1200ms at 200 QPS.

Procurement note: procurement@bluepeak.ai has asked for your SOC 2 summary and a sample MSA/redlined commercial terms. If you can share the SOC2 summary (PDF) and a standard enterprise MSA, we’ll circulate internally this week. Also include a simple TCO estimate comparing Dedicated vs Private (ballpark).

Also, one migration detail: we currently use an internal tokenizer and slightly modified model weights. Will Redwood support a model-variant path where we can pin custom weights (or bring our own model artifacts) into Dedicated/Private deployments? That’s a big gating factor.

Thanks — happy to take the 30-min follow-up on Friday morning ET.

— Daniel
Head of ML Platform, BluePeak Analytics
daniel@bluepeak.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosting preference & migration constraints

Daniel — great, thanks for the clarity. Short responses + confirmed next steps: 

- VPC private deployment fits your current needs; we can scope a customer-managed VPC peering and a Private deployment that keeps inference in EU regions (data plane). Control plane either hosted in our control plane or a private control plane depending on contract.
- We support bring-your-own-model (BYOM) artifacts for Dedicated and Private deployments. There are a few constraints around optimizations/quantization — our Applied ML team will help validate artifacts and provide a compatibility checklist.
- p99 target: we’ll run a quick capacity/sizing exercise to confirm GPU type and autoscaling policies to meet 200 QPS / 1200ms p99.
- SOC 2 summary and MSA: attaching SOC2 summary and an enterprise MSA template for your procurement team. Also attaching a short TCO comparison (ballpark) for Dedicated vs Private.

Proposed call: Fri, Jun 11 10:00 AM ET (30 min) — confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite. Agenda: sizing, BYOM constraints, procurement timeline, MAP ownership.

If procurement wants an initial redline, Priyom can lead that. Karthik will run the BYOM compatibility checklist on a sample artifact.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-enterprise-msa.docx, redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf, redwood-tco-dedicated-vs-private.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosting preference & migration constraints — procurement handoff

Hi Daniel / Jordan — looping in procurement routing and next steps from our side.

Procurement checklist (quick):
- Sign MSA + addendum for Private/VPC deployment (if private is chosen)
- Confirm SLA tier (we recommend Dedicated Enterprise for BluePeak based on QPS targets)
- Finalize compliance docs: signed SOC 2, Data Processing Addendum (DPA), and KMS requirements
- Pricing: we can provide a 60-day trial window on Dedicated for validation, then convert to reserved capacity commit if you want price predictability.

Proposed immediate deliverables from Redwood:
1) Completed MAP with milestones and owners (I attached the template Jordan shared)
2) Sample BYOM checklist and a runbook for onboarding custom model weights to Dedicated/Private
3) SOC2 PDF and marked MSA with standard commercial terms

Daniel — I’ll send the MAP and BYOM checklist after the call. If procurement wants to kick off redlines, copy me on the thread and I’ll shepherd.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
